description: SESE consumption graph. A recipient consume request verifies the exact mailbox owner, reads durable payloads, then commits ReceiveCommitted with Delivered/Acked in the same transaction. First receive and receive-id replay use one projection of the durable body, message identity, correlation and reply obligation; delivery-attempt diagnostics remain in their owner and are not part of the default receipt. The ordinary CLI checks the current available batch and returns an empty result when none is available; only explicit --timeout N opts into waiting in the poll owner. An empty result does not create a consumption receipt. Native acceptance and received receipt are not consumption. Late or old-generation receipts must not consume a newer binding. The existing subscription owner may idempotently advance its occurrence. Consumption does not change route, transport or binding truth. A fixture or graph validation does not prove live LLM consumption; that requires a real agent recv and receipt.

nodes.description: Owner is the mailbox/name owner. Resolve the recipient from the exact current project/name binding or receive-id replay, then accept only messages owned by that mailbox. Missing, mismatched, ambiguous or unreadable message identity keeps the existing explicit MESSAGE_ID_INVALID/MESSAGE_NOT_FOUND/MESSAGE_LOOKUP_FAILED result and does not consume. Native acceptance is not owner verification.

Owner is the durable mailbox payload reader. Project body, sender, correlation, receive-id and reply obligation from the same durable message state. Reading, inbox projection or terminal echo does not consume the message and does not prove the agent received it.

Owner is the mailbox consumption transaction. Commit ReceiveCommitted together with Delivered/Acked after the exact payload read; same receive-id replay reuses the receipt and does not double-consume. Only this commit represents consumption. Reply is a separate correlated send and sending it is not proof that the consumer received it. A real agent recv receipt is required for live LLM consumption; fixture and graph evidence are insufficient.
